# Deployment inventory manifest for agent-playbook.
# Format: kind<TAB>dest<TAB>source<TAB>mode
# - kind: symlink-file | symlink-dir | copy-file | copy-dir-recursive | merge-file
#         | template-file | seed-file
# - template-file: copied with {{USER_HOME}} / {{PLAYBOOK_ROOT}} substituted at deploy
#   time. Tokens expand to the platform-native root written with forward slashes
#   (C:/Users/X on Windows, from setup.sh under Git Bash as from setup.ps1, so both write
#   the same bytes; {{PLAYBOOK_ROOT}} with no 8.3 short names), so no consumer needs a
#   backslash escape; authors MUST use
#   forward slashes for everything after the token too (Windows tolerates the mixed
#   form, POSIX needs it). Consumers are JSON, markdown, and YAML values written in
#   double quotes.
# - seed-file: a template-file that is written ONLY when the destination is absent,
#   and verified for PRESENCE rather than content. For config the app itself rewrites
#   at runtime (mcp.json) the repo copy is a restore seed, not a managed artifact --
#   so an in-app edit must not report DRIFTED, and a deploy must never clobber the
#   live file. Refresh the repo copy deliberately when you want to capture changes.
# - dest: deployment target path. `~` expands to the user home; `<KIRO_IDE_USER>`
#   expands to the Kiro IDE per-user config dir, which is platform-divergent:
#   %APPDATA%\Kiro\User on Windows, ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/Kiro/User on POSIX.
#   Each setup/verify twin resolves it for its own platform.
# - source: repo-relative path to the source file/dir
# - mode: claude | codex | gemini | kiro-always | kiro
# Consumers: setup.ps1, setup.sh, verify-deployment.py, test-parity.sh
# Dynamic entries (per-skill symlinks/copies, overlay merges) are NOT listed here: every
# provider gets one link per shared skill inside its own skills/ folder (never a link of
# the whole folder), so its other skills stay.
# They remain auto-discovered at runtime from the filesystem.
# Mode `kiro` rows are symlinked by BOTH setup twins (Windows copy mode was retired
# 2026-09-20). Overlay-bearing Kiro skills are the only generated copies, and they are
# dynamic entries, not manifest rows.
# --- Claude Code ---

# authoring reference always-resident. kiro-always copies it outside steering.

# (see the template-file note above). The workspace-relative file://memory/*.md
# loads only an in-workspace memory/ on a workspace-root start; project memory is
# in the store repo since plan 261016 (see kiro-guidelines.md).
